items.title: Walmart CEO Is Launching AI Agent Profiles as United Airlines Blocks Third-Party Agents
items.summary: Key TakeawaysWalmart (WMT) is preparing to launch AI agent profiles that let customers authorize purchases and set spending limits, while United Airlines (UAL) is restricting unauthorized third-party AI agents from booking flights. Amazon (AMZN) has restricted outside AI shopping agents, while Shopify (SHOP) expanded checkout access for browser-based agents in September, showing how differently companies are approaching AI-powered commerce.
